title: The Shop on the Corner
sentences: The small shop on our corner closed in February.
It had been there for more than thirty years.
The owner was retiring and no one wanted to take it over.
For a while the street felt oddly empty without it.
It was the only place where people stopped to talk.
Now everyone drives to the large supermarket instead.
The shopping is cheaper there, and the choice is better.
But I no longer know the names of the people on my street.
A cafe opened in the same building in the summer.
It is busy, though the customers all seem to come from elsewhere.
